name: Mei Lin
bio:
Mei Lin's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for the intricate designs and vibrant colors of race cars. Growing up in Shanghai, she spent hours sketching cars and experimenting with different painting techniques. This passion led her to pursue a degree in automotive design, where she specialized in paint technology and surface finishing.

After graduating, Mei secured an internship at a local tuning shop, quickly mastering the art of custom paint jobs and vinyl wraps. Her meticulous attention to detail and creative flair caught the attention of Boutsen VDS, who offered her a position in their paint shop. Mei approaches her work with a blend of technical precision and artistic vision, constantly seeking new ways to enhance the aesthetic appeal and aerodynamic efficiency of the team's vehicles. Her calm demeanor and innovative problem-solving skills make her an invaluable asset to the team.

Mei is known for her ability to create stunning paint schemes that not only look great but also improve the car's performance. She's particularly adept at working with specialized paints and coatings to reduce drag and increase durability. Her innovative approach to surface finishing has earned her the respect of her colleagues and the admiration of fans.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair with subtle highlights, often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Mei is petite and athletic with a focused gaze and perpetually paint-stained hands.

quirks: Always wears noise-canceling headphones while working, even when there's no loud machinery.
Has a collection of miniature race cars displayed on her workbench, each meticulously painted.
Drinks green tea religiously throughout the day, claiming it enhances her focus.
